issues.t: CVT judder, hesitation or failure
issues.sym: Shuddering or jerking when pulling away, hesitation, the engine revving without the car picking up speed, or the car suddenly slowing and refusing to go faster. Some cars stop moving altogether.
issues.why: The Rogue Sport uses a continuously variable transmission (CVT). Wear inside it causes judder and slipping, and owners report full failures from roughly 60,000 to 90,000 miles. Nissan has bulletins for judder-related codes such as P17F0 and P17F1.
issues.next: Get it checked early. Ask the dealer to read the codes, look for software updates and check the fluid. If it slips or won't move, stop driving it hard. Ask Nissan about any goodwill or extended CVT coverage before paying for a replacement.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking slams on for no reason
issues.sym: The car brakes hard or beeps a collision warning with nothing in the way, often on the highway, under bridges or near parked cars. This can risk a rear-end crash.
issues.why: The forward radar and camera can misread things like overpasses, shadows or railroad tracks. This is the top complaint area for the 2019 model, and Nissan issued bulletin NTB18-041E for false activations.
issues.next: Keep the front sensor and windshield area clean. Ask a dealer to apply the bulletin's software update and recalibrate the sensors, and report repeat events to NHTSA. You can turn the system off in the settings while waiting, but drive with extra care if you do.

issues.t: Radiator cooling fan fails and engine overheats
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs in traffic or with the A/C on, the A/C gets weak, and in bad cases the engine overheats and steams.
issues.why: The electric radiator fan assembly can stop working, often around 40,000 to 70,000 miles according to owner reports. The same fan cools both the engine and the A/C condenser.
issues.next: If the gauge climbs, pull over and shut the engine off. Driving while overheating can ruin the engine. Have the fan, its fuse and relay tested.

issues.t: Check engine light with weak acceleration from CVT codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on and the car feels down on power or hesitates. Codes such as P0776 or P1715 may be stored.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB18-077b covers these transmission pressure and speed codes along with hesitation and lack of power.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer to check this bulletin before agreeing to a transmission replacement.

issues.t: Long crank, stalling or rough idle when cold
issues.sym: The engine takes a long time to start on cold mornings, then may idle roughly, misfire, hesitate or stall.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB17-113c covers this cold-start behavior on 2017-2020 Rogue Sports. The fix is an engine computer update.
issues.next: Ask the dealer whether the bulletin's software update has been done on your car.

issues.t: Forward collision system error or blinking AEB light
issues.sym: The emergency braking warning light blinks, or the dash shows a forward collision "system error" with nothing in front of the car.
issues.why: Nissan issued bulletin NTB19-042a for the blinking AEB light and a separate bulletin for radar and camera reprogramming.
issues.next: Clean the front sensor and windshield and restart the car. If it comes back, have the dealer read the codes and update the software.

issues.t: Folding key can switch off the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The flip-out key can fold up while you drive. If your knee bumps it, the engine may shut off, and the airbags may not work in a crash.
issues.why: The jackknife-style key on these cars can collapse in the ignition (NHTSA campaign 23V-093, shared with 2014-2020 Rogues).
issues.next: Until the fix is done, take everything else off the key ring and use only the key. A dealer will fit a free spacer in the key slot.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be turned off (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture may not appear when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: The display settings let the camera image be switched off, and the setting stays off, which breaks the federal rear-visibility rule (NHTSA campaign 19V-654).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer will update the camera settings software for free.

issues.t: Seat belt child-seat lock may release early (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign. A child seat held by the seat belt may not stay as tight as it should.
issues.why: The automatic locking feature in some front passenger and rear outer seat belts can switch off too early (NHTSA campaign 21V-555).
issues.next: Use the LATCH anchors for child seats if you can until the recall is done. Dealers replace the affected belts for free.

issues.t: Liftgate hinges can separate in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign in normal driving.
issues.why: The liftgate hinges on some 2021 Rogue Sports may not be strong enough and can come apart in a rear-end crash (NHTSA campaign 21V-525).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer will replace both hinges for free.

issues.t: Key not detected and engine won't start
issues.sym: The dash says the key isn't detected and the car won't start, even with the key inside.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB13-107G covers Intelligent Key detection problems. A weak key fob battery is the simplest cause; antenna or control module faults are less common.
issues.next: Replace the key fob battery first. To start the car meanwhile, hold the fob against the start button. If that doesn't help, have the dealer follow the bulletin.

issues.t: Fluid leak at right front axle seal
issues.sym: Oil spots under the front of the car near the passenger side, or a wet seal behind the right front wheel.
issues.why: The oil seal where the right drive shaft enters the transfer case (AWD) or transmission can leak. Nissan has bulletins on this seal.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed and the fluid level checked. Replacing the seal is a fairly small job if caught early.

issues.t: Vibration or noise in slow tight turns
issues.sym: A shudder, groan or vibration when turning sharply at low speed, such as in parking lots.
issues.why: Nissan issued bulletin NTB20-069 for this noise on Rogue and Rogue Sport models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletin. Note when it happens (cold or warm, AWD or FWD) to help them reproduce it.

issues.t: Touchscreen and NissanConnect glitches
issues.sym: The touchscreen freezes or restarts, Bluetooth drops, or navigation and connected features act up.
issues.why: Nissan released several software updates for the infotainment and NissanConnect system on these years.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to install the latest infotainment software.

issues.t: No airflow from vents after snow gets into the intake
issues.sym: Little or no air from the vents in snowy weather, making it hard to defrost the windshield.
issues.why: Snow can build up in the climate system's air intake. Nissan bulletin NTB20-098 covers this.
issues.next: Clear snow from the base of the windshield before driving. Ask the dealer about the bulletin fix.

issues.t: Lane departure warning acts up after windshield work
issues.sym: Lane departure warnings come on at the wrong time or not at all, often after a windshield replacement.
issues.why: The lane camera behind the windshield must be aimed correctly. Nissan bulletin NTB20-066C adds the aiming values needed to set it up.
issues.next: Have the lane camera aimed by a shop that can do Nissan camera calibration.

issues.t: Check engine light for cold start control code
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P2B95 stored, usually with no driving symptoms.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB23-083 covers this code, and the fix is an engine computer reprogram.
issues.next: Have the code confirmed and ask the dealer for the bulletin's software update.

issues.t: Check engine light from engine computer self-test codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P060A or P060C stored.
issues.why: These codes point to the engine computer's internal checks. Nissan bulletin NTB21-075 covers how to fix them.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer to apply the bulletin.

issues.t: Rear automatic braking warning light
issues.sym: A rear automatic braking (RAB) warning comes on and the feature stops working.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB22-038A covers the RAB warning with code B2724-23 stored.
issues.next: Clean the rear bumper sensors, then have the dealer check the code if the warning stays on.

issues.t: Remote engine start doesn't work
issues.sym: Pressing remote start on the key fob does nothing.
issues.why: Nissan bulletin NTB14-012G covers remote start problems, which can come from the setup, the hood switch or a module fault.
issues.next: Make sure the hood is fully latched and the doors are locked, then ask the dealer to follow the bulletin.
